name: dogfood-llm-hallucination-eval-app
description: Dogfood app v1.38-3 — a Hallucination detection + LLM eval service that drives an LLM answer-quality surface backed by @kiwa-lab/ai-llm v0.4 semantics (hallucination self-consistency/factuality/citation/confidence + llm-eval judge/rubric/preference/Elo), runnable in both KIWA_MODE=real (OpenAI Chat Completions API when OPENAI_API_KEY + budget guard are set) and KIWA_MODE=mock (in-memory scorer + judge pipeline) so behavioural fidelity feeds @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics 11-axis release gate.

scripts.test: node ../../scripts/build-deps.mjs @kiwa-lab/ai-llm @kiwa-lab/core @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
